gate_description: Same gate as RUN-RELN-141a86-stage0bcde/recovery-controls.json and RUN-RELN-141a86-stage0c-repair/recovery-controls.json (specification.yaml frozen_pipeline.primary_engine.grammar.node_counting_rule / controls.stage0_recovery_*): per-control PASS requires BOTH (a) numeric zero-residual verification of the known target expression against real generated/measured data with free CONST placeholders fit exactly, AND (b) confirmation that the SAME expression (or an algebraically equivalent form) is discoverable at or below the target's canonical node count.
method_note: THIS RUN USES TARGETED MINIMALITY, NOT BLIND SEARCH, per DEC-20260907-2a3727 and TASK-20260907-6333af. Recovery is established here by TWO SEPARATE, DISTINCT checks per target: (a) exhaustive enumeration of the leaf pack strictly BELOW the target's own canonical complexity (i.e. up to canonical_complexity - 1), confirming NO expression at any of those lower levels numerically matches the target (checked via the same numeric-fingerprint-on-fixed-sample-grid equivalence relation the frozen engine already uses throughout this contract for algebraic-duplicate dedup); PLUS (b) direct construction of the target's own known closed-form expression in the grammar's representation, confirmed to have EXACTLY the canonical node count under grammar_engine.node_count and ZERO residual against the real control table. Together (a)+(b) prove the known form is the UNIQUE minimal-complexity match. This is methodologically DISTINCT from 'recovered by blind search' (which is what INV-A4 and INV-A6 achieved in RUN-RELN-141a86-stage0bcde) and is labeled 'recovered by targeted minimality' below wherever it applies -- never conflated with blind discovery.

INV-1_conservation_mean.gate_verdict: RECOVERED BY TARGETED MINIMALITY (part (a) exhaustively found no match at complexity <= 8; part (b) confirms the known closed form exists at exactly complexity 9 with zero residual on 144 real cells; together the known form is the unique minimal-complexity match). Distinct from blind-search recovery.

p_fail.gate_verdict: RECOVERED BY TARGETED MINIMALITY (part (a) exhaustively found no match at complexity <= 8; part (b) confirms the known closed form exists at exactly complexity 9 with zero residual on 15 real cells). Distinct from blind-search recovery.

part_a_minimality_search.note: Killed mid-construction of level 9 (never completed); levels 1-8 exhaustively completed with no match, preserved by the between-level checkpoint (this is the same pack and same completed-level data as p_fail's run, since both start from the same leaf set -- level 9 was never reached for either p_fail, which only needed level <= 8, or p_exist, which needed level <= 10). Level 9's own candidate count is estimated (from the measured level 7->8 growth factor of ~7.5x applied to level 8's 3,314,145 forms) at roughly 2.5x10^7, and level 10 at roughly 1.9x10^8; extrapolating the measured per-candidate cost from level 8 (~1400s for ~2.9M new candidates, i.e. ~486 candidates/sec) implies level 9 alone would require on the order of 12-14 hours of additional wall clock, and level 10 a further ~9-10x that -- well beyond this run's 6000s cap and beyond what was judged a reasonable single-attempt extension given the other three targets already cleared. NOT a negative result; NOT re-attempted with a longer cap in this run.

part_b_direct_construction.note: Residual is IEEE-754 floating-point epsilon (1 - p_fail computed in float64), not exactly the bit pattern 0.0; treated as zero-residual per the tolerance (1e-9) used throughout this contract's numeric_verification checks and consistent with RUN-RELN-141a86-stage0bcde and -stage0c-repair's own characterization of this identical expression ('exact match (float precision, residual 1.1e-16)'). Reported exactly, never rounded away.

p_exist.gate_verdict: NOT RECOVERED BY EITHER METHOD (blind search failed twice with resource_exhaustion at complexity 11 in stage0bcde/stage0c-repair; targeted minimality in THIS run reaches only complexity 8 of the required <=10 before resource_exhaustion, so minimality is UNPROVEN -- part (b)'s numeric identity is confirmed but part (a) is incomplete). STILL OPEN, exactly as anticipated by DEC-20260907-2a3727 and TASK-20260907-6333af. This is failed_infrastructure (resource_exhaustion), never a negative or positive scientific result.

INV-7_xclass_m2.gate_verdict_combined: p_fail RECOVERED BY TARGETED MINIMALITY; p_exist STILL OPEN (resource_exhaustion, both methods).

INV-8_semiregular_degree.gate_verdict: RECOVERED BY TARGETED MINIMALITY (part (a) exhaustively found no match at complexity <= 9, the closest of the three main targets to the resource ceiling measured, peak 4.44 GB; part (b) confirms the known closed form exists at exactly complexity 10 with zero residual on 549 real rows). Distinct from blind-search recovery.

summary.hard_gate_verdict_5_of_5: 4 of 5 recovery controls now recovered (INV-1, INV-7-p_fail, INV-8 by targeted minimality this run; INV-A4, INV-A6 by blind search, carried forward). INV-7 p_exist remains NOT AFFIRMATIVELY RECOVERED by either method (resource_exhaustion both times). Per the contract's OWN stopping_rules ('Stop at the end of Stage 0c if any recovery control is not recovered on the primary engine ... instrument failure, not evidence') this is a STRICT reading in which the 5-control gate has NOT been fully passed, since INV-7 p_exist is one of the five pre-registered recovery controls named in controls.stage0_recovery_INV7_m2_exact_law. THE EXECUTOR DOES NOT UNILATERALLY DECIDE WHETHER A 4-OF-5 PASS IS SUFFICIENT TO PROCEED TO STAGE 1 -- per TASK-20260907-6333af's own explicit instruction, this is reported to the Coordinator as an open question requiring a decision, not resolved here.
summary.targeted_minimality_vs_blind_search_disc: INV-1, INV-7-p_fail and INV-8's recovery in THIS run is a methodologically DISTINCT claim from a blind-search PASS: it proves no lower-complexity expression numerically matches (via exhaustive enumeration one full level short of the target, using the same numeric-fingerprint equivalence relation used throughout this contract) PLUS that the known closed form exists at exactly the canonical complexity with zero residual on real data -- together proving the known form is the unique minimal-complexity match, which is at least as strong for the purpose of this gate but is NOT the literal blind-discovery act the gate's original text describes. This must be reviewed and reported as such.
